name: Kannazuki Hotori
source:
Hotori is very laidback; she dislikes moving her body or putting effort into doing anything. She loves looking at the stars, but most of the time she finds the preparations for it too bothersome, so she just gives up and goes home. She calls [url=/c98235]Koyoi[/url] "Hoshi-chan". She and [url=/c98598]Ruri[/url] are childhood friends.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
